d_antilink: Stops links even when disguised: full-width letters, look-alike dots, “site dot com”, links on buttons. The «Allowed links» list and links to this group are fine.
d_antiads: Stops advertisers and tabchi (spam accounts): a new member's first link, contact or channel forward; the same ad posted in other Aegis groups; ad phrases with a contact.
d_flood: Stops message floods: too many messages in a short time, or the same message again and again.
d_raid: Notices a raid — many joins at once — and switches on raid mode for a while: a captcha or quarantine for newcomers, an emergency lock, or just an alert.
d_captcha: Newcomers are muted until they press the right button. Unsolved in time: kicked (or banned, or kept muted). With join requests the captcha goes to their private chat and decides the request.
d_quarantine: Newcomers can only send text (or nothing) for a while after joining. Telegram lifts it by itself when the time is up.
d_suspicious: Invisible characters, look-alike letters («раypal»), scam and deceptive text, dangerous files (.apk, .exe, photo.jpg.exe …) and the same media again and again.
d_risk: Adds up the signals of a message or a newcomer into a score, explains it, alerts the admins and acts above the threshold. ✅/❌ on each alert teaches the weights for this group.
home_intro: Admins, Aegis, the anonymous admin and the VIP and trusted lists are never caught. Open a module to switch it on and set it up.
basic_group: ℹ️ Captcha, quarantine, emergency lock and read-only need a supergroup: Telegram can't restrict members of a basic group.
bot_cant_invite: ⚠️ Aegis needs «Invite users» to approve or decline join requests.
emergency_intro: Members can't send anything until it ends; admins still can. The group's permissions are saved and put back automatically at the end.
readonly_intro: Members can read but not write — for announcements or quiet hours. The permissions are put back automatically at the end.
emergency_q: Lock {title} now ({time})? Members won't be able to send messages.
emergency_started: 🚨 Emergency lock by {who}: members can't send messages for now.
readonly_started: 📖 Read-only mode by {who}: members can read but not write.
emergency_ended: 🔓 Emergency lock ended by {who}: everyone can write again.
emergency_restored: 🔓 The emergency lock is over: everyone can write again.
emergency_not_on: There is no emergency lock right now.
emergency_already: The emergency lock is already on.
lock_until: ⏱ Ends in {time}; the permissions are put back automatically.
need_restrict: You need Telegram's «Ban users» right for this.
admins_only: Only admins with the right to ban users can do this.
settings_only: This needs access level «Settings» in that group.
cp_button: To show you're a person, press {target}
cp_math: To show you're a person, solve: {target} = ?
cp_time: ⏱ You have {time}. Until then you can't write here.
cp_request: 👋 You asked to join {title}. To show you're a person:
cp_request_ok: ✅ Thanks! Your request to join {title} was approved.
cp_request_failed: ❌ Your request to join {title} was declined: the captcha wasn't solved.
cp_not_yours: This captcha is for someone else.
log_captcha_expired: ⏱ {user} didn't solve the captcha in time.
log_captcha_removed: ❌ {user} was removed by an admin from the captcha.
log_captcha_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — {user} didn't pass the captcha (nothing done).
log_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — would have acted on a message of {user}: {what}
sig_impersonation: name imitates an admin or Telegram
sig_new_link: new member posting a link or contact
sig_first_link: first message has a link or contact
sig_xgroup: the same ad in other groups
sig_fwd_channel_new: new member forwarding from a channel
feedback_right: ✅ Thanks — these signals will count a little more here.
feedback_wrong: ❌ Thanks — undone where possible; these signals will count less here.
weights_learned: Learned from the admins' feedback: {n} signals adjusted.
raid_act_quarantine: Newcomers are muted for a while.
raid_act_audit: Audit Mode: nothing is done automatically.
fbanned: 🌐 {target} banned in the federation {fed}: banned in {n} of {total} groups. Reason: {reason}
fed_none: This group is in no federation (panel → 🌐 Federation).
fed_not_admin: Only the owner and admins of the federation {fed} can do this.
fed_protected: Aegis, yourself and federation admins can't be fed-banned.
fed_usage: Usage: reply with /{cmd} [reason], or /{cmd} @username or id [reason].
log_fed_ban_here: 🌐 {user} is banned in the federation {fed}: banned here too. Reason: {reason}
log_fed_declined: 🌐 Join request of {user} declined: banned in the federation {fed}.
night_ended: ☀️ The night lock was ended by {who}.
night_restored: ☀️ Good morning! The group is open again.
